propositions: The rebar-mcp container must be provisioned to sign op-certs (plan-review and completion-verifier) under the existing pinned environment 9f1c8e42 by composing a signer binding from REBAR_OPCERT_ENV_ID and the materialized Ed25519 key path

A plan-review or completion-verifier op-cert minted by the container must verify successfully against the pinned public key in trusted_environments.yaml, while an otherwise identical cert signed by an unregistered key must be rejected

The enforce/grandfather mechanism must enforce only tickets closed after an opcert_enforce_since boundary when verify.require_environment is set, while grandfathering pre-boundary closes as advisory (exit 0)

A deferred human-run operator runbook must document the authoritative rebar.toml [verify] flip with exact keys, preconditions that all post-boundary closes route through the 9f1c8e42 signer, expand-contract ordering, and rollback procedure

The container signing provisioning (move 1) is additive and reversible with no new environment or key material committed, and the enforcement flip (move 2) is carved out as a deferred operator step to prevent retroactive merge-gate failures on local-CLI closes
